name: account-singularity-extension
description: Browser extension for account-singularity: detects login/signup forms and relays fill requests to the local vault over native messaging.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run gen:icons && vite build && node scripts/build-content.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test
scripts.safari: npm run build && xcrun safari-web-extension-converter dist --project-location safari --bundle-identifier com.account-singularity.extension --no-open --force
